name: nhtsa-vpic-vin
description: Decode VINs (NHTSA vPIC), list NHTSA recalls and owner-complaint summaries, run a used-car buyer's check (inspection list derived from the vehicle's own recall/complaint components), and pull EPA fueleconomy.gov MPG/MPGe, range, annual fuel cost, CO2 and 5-year save/spend — for Diag Desk, Side Lane, and Ambrosia's Automotive workflows. All free, no-auth public APIs. Recalls are year/make/model-level, not VIN-confirmed. Never invents API data.
